resources.string: Tries to keep can-talk voice and feedback sounds at a steady level when you change call volume. Audio starts quieter to leave room for compensation. Results depend on your phone and voice engine.

Voice and feedback sound level during calls, from 5 to 100 %. Each 5-point step reduces audio more noticeably. During a call, hold a finger on the screen and press the volume buttons to adjust it. Changes apply to the next spoken phrase and feedback sound.
Reader volume during the call: %1$d percent
